newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB halts buyback until after Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: NAB halts buyback until after Q3 results.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Monday that it would not proceed with its share buy-back programme until after it had released its third quarter profit result on July 24.
The bank, Australia's largest and most profitable private bank, said it had bought 57.714 million shares under the programme, with another 31.537 million to be acquired.

It also said the current programme would be increased to include the 14 million shares expected to be issued under the July 1997 dividend reinvestment, bonus share and share top-up plans. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
